cause: Windows child-window creation used glutin finalize_window, which disabled requested transparency when WGL TRANSPARENT_ARB was false despite working DWM alpha composition

before.method: Native screen pixel strictly inside own transparent child over own opaque green host; no other desktop contents recorded

after.method: Native screen pixels strictly inside own transparent child over own opaque green host; no other desktop contents recorded

limits: Pixels sampled strictly within own green host and own overlay; no general desktop capture
No physical keyboard or mouse automation
No user opacity or theme setting changes
